272:t_009:40.en:
$$タケル$$
「If they stand in humanity's future... If they are the fundamental calamity...!」

272:t_009:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll overcome them with all we've got!!」

272:t_010:0.en:
$$隼人$$
「That was a victory by the narrowest margin...」

272:t_010:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ and monsters are nothing like $$サイデリアル$$'s forces so far.」

272:t_010:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「The enemies shatter our hearts through awe... They're $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」

272:t_010:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are they our true enemies... Humanity's fundamental calamity...?」

272:t_011:0.en:
$$隼人$$
「Their strength... is on another level.」

272:t_011:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ and monsters are nothing like $$サイデリアル$$'s forces so far!」

272:t_011:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「The enemies shatter our hearts through awe... They're $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」

272:t_011:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are they our true enemies... Humanity's fundamental calamity...!?」

272:t_012:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「You're kidding...! How are we supposed to fight those things!?」

272:t_012:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「...Is this... as far as we go...?」

272:t_012:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「N-no...! I still... don't want to die!」

272:t_012:5.en:
$$青山$$
(I'm sorry, Mom... I don't think I can come home...)

272:t_012:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
(So the end... comes this suddenly...)

272:t_012:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't lose heart! This isn't over yet!」

272:t_012:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「You can give up and despair later! Right now, let's do what we have to!」

272:t_012:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll fight! I can still feel pain... I'm alive!!」

272:t_014:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「What...!? $$ガンレオン$$ is... crying!」

272:t_014:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait! Aren't you the one who sent us here, too!?」

272:t_014:5.en:
???
「$$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$... You endure pain and fear...」

272:t_014:6.en:
???
「One day, you will understand everything... Then you will walk the path of $$シンカ$$, and all the universes...」

272:t_015:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「This is bad. Our power section has been hit.」

272:t_015:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Is it impossible... to get through this battle unscathed...?」

272:t_016:0.en:
$$凱$$
「This is bad, $$號$$! We can't shake the enemy!」

272:t_016:2.en:
$$號$$
「We fight with everything we've got...! It's all we can do!」

272:t_100:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(I'm sorry, Miss $$美重子$$... I... might never graduate from elementary school...)

272:t_100:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(But I... want to see everyone again...! So... So!!)

272:t_101:0.en:
$$柿小路$$
(Perhaps I won't have to worry about the company going bankrupt anymore...)

272:t_101:1.en:
$$厚井$$
($$竜介$$... I'm counting on you to take care of your mother...)

272:t_101:2.en:
$$木下$$
(I wish... I'd gotten my bonus...)

272:t_101:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
(We really can't fight enemies like those in a shuttle...)

272:t_101:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「...But, everyone...! As long as the President is fighting, we, his employees, cannot retreat!」

272:t_101:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「H-here we go! Whatever the enemy is, we fight as employees of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$!」

272:t_102:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
($$鉄人$$ is a robot, so fear can't defeat him...)

272:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
(If I, his pilot, get scared, I'll only put $$鉄人$$ in danger...! Even if I'm scared... I have to fight!)

272:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't flinch, $$オックス$$! We'll do our best, too! So...!」

272:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
(I'm scared... I haven't felt this way since I first piloted $$マジンガー$$...)

272:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
(...Back then, I fought to protect $$シロー$$... to stay alive myself! This is no different!)

272:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
(I have to do this...! Hope will guide me!)

272:t_105:0.en:
$$さやか$$
(Father... I... may never see you again...)

272:t_105:1.en:
$$さやか$$
(But I'll fight...! As long as $$甲児$$ is here, I'll stake my life on it...!)

272:t_106:1.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「I-I know it's odd coming from me, but this is reckless!」

272:t_106:2.en:
$$ボス$$
「S-shut up! We have to do it!」

272:t_106:3.en:
$$ボス$$
(I-I'm scared out of my mind, too! But...!)

272:t_106:4.en:
$$ボス$$
(When you guys are scared, I can't afford to be scared, too! I'm your boss!)

272:t_107:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Dammit... Damn it! No matter how many times I shake it off, fear wells up from the bottom of my heart!」

272:t_107:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're not the only ones I have to defeat! I have to defeat the weakness inside me!」

272:t_108:0.en:
$$隼人$$
(That was close... If I hadn't seen $$ミチル$$ again, guilt would have crushed me...)

272:t_108:1.en:
$$隼人$$
(What the hell are these things...? Are they trying to break our hearts...?)

272:t_109:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
(It's true we... I couldn't save $$武蔵$$...!)

272:t_109:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
(Sometimes that regret nearly crushed me...! But now... Now that I've found something more important to do, I can fight!)

272:t_109:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
(Whatever you do, my heart won't waver as long as I have my promise to $$武蔵$$!)

272:t_110:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(But I won't lose to this pain...! I'll fight to keep my promise to you... to protect peace in this universe!)

272:t_111:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
(This is bad... The strength is draining from my body...)

272:t_111:2.en:
$$ミカ$$
(My will to fight is draining from my heart...)

272:t_111:3.en:
$$ロゼ$$
(We... can't match them... Humans... cannot defeat gods...)

272:t_111:5.en:
$$ケンジ$$
(But even so, we'll fight...! We must still have our pride as the $$クラッシャー隊$$!)

272:t_112:1.en:
$$シモン$$
(...If I have time for regrets, I look ahead... That's how I've lived... And from now on, too...!)
